note: rofix (2026-10-22, docs/137 §12, docs/136 §8, docs/89 §11, docs/51 §218): verify jobs first (day, 5 min, counters only), then the both-order timing pairs (clean night). asi game-copy/ts3native.asi.0321 sha256 4233eec8e5fb4747a377dcc4d8f850b5a310ed1aad1a7120fbb554f834796575. No feature behaviour changed: the build only fixes the wait-key accounting, so the pairs re-measure whether any wait is really removed.

jobs.note: Day job (5 min, noisy machine OK: counters and log lines only, no timing). ts3native 0.36.21 combined build incl. rofix (game-copy/ts3native.asi.0321, sha256 4233eec8...96575): wait keys 0x846D21/0x62F782/0x833593/0x83156D and the other A/B keys keep their probe-P0 slots from the start; AvoidRO pass-through keyed 0x846D21 again (was AvSite's own return, e.g. 0x6F28F468). Run from a checkout whose ts3native.ini is master (v0.1.4 release defaults); ts3fixes as master. 1-min slices (warm-up on, then off,on,on,off). Read: node tools/harness/wait-ab.ts rofix-ab-<date>-<id>. Pass for every verify job: no crash, game alive, 0 watchdog lines, the switch line in the log at every slice, wait-ab shows the feature key with time in the off half and "untimed waits/min" within 2x between halves (docs/51 §218). [AvoidRO] Mode=1 Shadow=1 (--ab avoidro toggles Mode; the shadow compares with no job in every slice). Pass: avShadowRuns > 500, avShadowMismatch = avShadowMismatchB = avShadowQueryMismatch = 0, avSiteSkip = avTakenMiss > 0 and avTakenB > 0 in on slices, avFb* < 5% of avTakenMiss, avTripAv counted but avFbTrip small, key 0x846D21 ~0 ms/s on vs > 0 off, no blockKey in 0x10000000+ (asi range). avTakenHit is NOT a pass rule: it counts footprint-id answers only, and goal points rarely lie in a footprint (2026-10-21 shadow: 43,186 runs, 0 mismatches, 294 Sim-scan answers; every answered call so far was a correct miss).

Clean night only (docs/TESTING.md clean-night rules). Same asi and base as the verify jobs; 10 min, 2-min slices; read the off-first and on-first jobs together (pair means only). Timing re-measure with every A/B key timed in both halves (the 2026-10-21/22 pairs lost the removed key's off-half time to blockOther, docs/51 §218). Expected (docs/137 §12, docs/136 §8, docs/89 §11): the feature key drops to ~0 and the summed keyed +0x918 wait stays within ~±5 ms/s (the wait is conserved: it moves to the next acquirer in the same tick); it/s within the BP pair noise (SD of pair means 5.0% over 10 BP switch pairs). --ab avoidro, key 0x846D21; off-first (warm-up on, then off,on,on,off).
